shell.alertsEmpty: No alerts yet. They will appear here once the alerts service is wired.

tenant.switchToView: Switch to this tenant to view its farms.

home.comingSoon: You do not have a farm yet. Ask your administrator to add you to one, or to give you permission to create one.
home.noFarmsBody: A farm is the starting point. Create one, then blocks, imagery, weather, alerts, and recommendations follow.

setup.title: Set up in six steps
setup.note: Each step has a written guide on the documentation site.

createFarm.title: Create a farm
createFarm.body: Draw the boundary on the map. Every other record hangs off the farm.

addBlocks.title: Add the blocks
addBlocks.body: Split the farm into blocks and give each block a crop.

gridCellSize.title: Set the grid cell size
gridCellSize.body: Choose the cell size that imagery and indices are summarised on.

imageryWeather.title: Turn on imagery and weather
imageryWeather.body: Subscribe the farm so satellite scenes and weather records start arriving.

attachPeople.title: Attach the people
attachPeople.body: Add users and workers, then give each one access to the farm.

checkArrived.title: Check what arrived
checkArrived.body: Confirm the first scenes, indices, and weather rows reached the farm.

capabilities.title: What you can do here
capabilities.body: AgriPulse covers eight processes. Each one has a guide.

mapTheFarm.title: Map the farm
mapTheFarm.body: Boundary, blocks, and the grid the field is read on.

planTheSeason.title: Plan the season
planTheSeason.body: Crops, plan templates, growth stages, and season tasks.

connectTheData.title: Connect the data
connectTheData.body: Satellite imagery and weather, per farm, on a schedule.

readTheField.title: Read the field
readTheField.body: Indices, trends, and maps, per block and per grid cell.

authorTheAgronomy.title: Write the agronomy
authorTheAgronomy.body: Signals, rules, and decision trees that turn readings into advice.

runTheFieldTeam.title: Run the field team
runTheFieldTeam.body: Workers, field access, and scouting forms on the mobile app.

closeTheLoop.title: Close the loop
closeTheLoop.body: Work alerts and recommendations, then record what was done.

operateThePlatform.title: Run the platform
operateThePlatform.body: Users, roles, tenants, and integration health.
